phase: Phase D3: the rest of the updates and the moderate/low list (by 2026-11-25)
summary: PASS with 0 Blocker and 5 Nit findings. Version 1.77.0 of lucide-react keeps the drawing of 28 of the 30 imported icon names and redraws two: BookOpen and BookOpenCheck. In the live app 22 distinct icons render and align, and the browser shows no console error or page error. Daniel must decide whether to accept the two new book drawings. The default is accept. Seven icons were not seen live, but their markup is identical in both versions.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Nit] ux-browser-review: dashboard/package.json:27 raises lucide-react from 0.563.0 to 1.77.0, and BookOpen and BookOpenCheck get a new drawing. The corner radius grows from 1 to 2 units. The top centre dip shrinks from 4 to 2 units. The bottom edge moves from y 18 to y 19. The bounding box stays 20 x 18 units, so each icon keeps its place. The changed pixels are 17.5 to 21.4 percent of the ink at 16, 24, and 96 px. The unchanged Plus control shows 0 percent. BookOpen shows in dashboard/components/dashboard-layout.tsx:11 (the logo on every page), dashboard/app/page.tsx:65, dashboard/app/projects/page.tsx:89, dashboard/app/projects/[projectId]/page.tsx:92, and :108. BookOpenCheck shows in dashboard/app/projects/[projectId]/page.tsx:114. Daniel decides whether to accept the new look. The default is accept. Plan decision (1) says no visible change, and this is not exact for these two icons. Evidence: /tmp/opencode/ux-d3/40-icon-compare-old-vs-new.png.

F2 [Nit] ux-browser-review: Five imported names are aliases in 1.77.0: CheckSquare, Edit, Home, Loader2, and Trash2. All five resolve, none has a deprecation mark, and the five drawings are identical to 0.563.0. Trash2 is now an alias of Trash, and the two were different icons in 0.563.0. Seven class lists change. CheckSquare, Edit, Home, Loader2, and Sparkles gain alias classes. Settings2 loses lucide-settings2. Trash2 changes from lucide-trash2 lucide-trash-2 to lucide-trash lucide-trash-2. No CSS, test, or script in dashboard/ selects a lucide- class, so D3 needs no action. Rationale: a later cleanup can use the names House, SquarePen, SquareCheckBig, LoaderCircle, and Trash.

F3 [Nit] ux-browser-review: These layout limits do not come from D3. At 1280 px the project page header row is wider than the main column. The button 'New Lesson from Source' is cut off, and the title wraps (screenshot 03; dashboard/app/projects/[projectId]/page.tsx:77 and :102). The fixed sidebar w-64 (dashboard/components/dashboard-layout.tsx:9) leaves a main column of 512 px at 768 px and 134 px at 390 px (screenshots 23 and 22). The document has no horizontal scroll, and main has overflow-auto (dashboard/components/dashboard-layout.tsx:47). The sidebar logo measures 20 x 24 px, not 24 x 24, because the flex row shrinks it (dashboard/components/dashboard-layout.tsx:11). The old and new icons have the same size attributes, so the upgrade does not change these sizes.

F4 [Nit] ux-browser-review: Icon-only controls at seven code sites have no accessible name, and D3 changes none of them. The five back controls are at dashboard/app/projects/[projectId]/page.tsx:81, dashboard/app/projects/[projectId]/lessons/[lessonId]/page.tsx:45, dashboard/app/projects/[projectId]/lessons/[lessonId]/preview/page.tsx:80, dashboard/app/projects/[projectId]/compile/page.tsx:90, and dashboard/app/projects/[projectId]/teacher-manual/preview/page.tsx:73. The clear button (dashboard/components/image-upload.tsx:152) and the delete button (dashboard/components/lesson-editor/ArticleEditor.tsx:133) also have no name. On the project page axe-core 4.12.1 reports button-name (critical, 1 node) and link-name (serious, 1 node). The icon keeps aria-hidden in lucide-react 1.77.0, so the icon gives no name. Rationale: an aria-label on each control fixes this, and the fix belongs in a later track.

F5 [Nit] ux-browser-review: Keyboard and navigation notes exist before D3. Each sidebar item has two tab stops, the link and the button inside it, so the 4 items need 8 Tab presses (dashboard/components/dashboard-layout.tsx:16 to :42). The Settings link opens /settings, which returns 404 (screenshot 11). Each page has two level-1 headings: the layout h1 at dashboard/components/dashboard-layout.tsx:12 and the page h1. Rationale: D3 changes none of this, so the notes only inform a later track.

Import scan: 18 import statements in 18 files under dashboard/ name 30 distinct imported names (461 source files scanned, node_modules and .next excluded). A 19th file, dashboard/__tests__/image-upload-component.test.tsx, mentions lucide-react in comments only. dashboard/lib/document-wrapper/icons.ts holds static lucide-static data and does not import lucide-react.

Shape check: all 30 names resolve in both versions (0 missing). I rendered each name with 5 prop sets in each version under React 19.3.1, which gives 150 pairs. After I remove the class attribute, 140 pairs are identical. The 10 other pairs belong to BookOpen and BookOpenCheck. My first run of the check and a second run in this audit gave the same result. The other UX run (see below) found the same 2 changed names.

Default props are identical for all 30 names in both versions. They are width 24, height 24, viewBox 0 0 24 24, fill none, stroke currentColor, stroke-width 2, round caps and joins, and aria-hidden true. XIcon, CheckIcon, ChevronDownIcon, and ChevronUpIcon are the same components as X, Check, ChevronDown, and ChevronUp in both versions.

Drawing change: BookOpen spine goes from M12 7v14 to M12 5v16, and BookOpenCheck spine goes from M12 21V7 to M12 5v16. The outline corner radius goes from 1 to 2 units, and the top centre dip goes from 4 to 2 units. The bottom edge goes from y 18 to y 19. The BookOpenCheck check mark m16 12 2 2 4-4 does not change.

CSS and test reliance: no css, scss, ts, or tsx file under dashboard/ selects a lucide- class. The shadcn Button rule [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4 (dashboard/components/ui/button.tsx:8) needs an svg element and a class without 'size-'. No icon class contains 'size-' in either version. dashboard/ uses no absoluteStrokeWidth, LucideProvider, createLucideIcon, DynamicIcon, or lucide-react sub-path import.

Deprecation: node_modules/lucide-react/dist/lucide-react.d.ts has 22 @deprecated lines. None concerns an icon that dashboard/ imports. The aliases CheckSquare, Edit, Home, Loader2, and Trash2 carry no mark.

Live app: next dev (Next.js 16.4.6, Turbopack) on 127.0.0.1:3117 ran in one heavy-run job from 04:37:56 to 04:41:28 on 2026-11-22 after a 38-minute queue wait. I started it with WORKBOOKS_READ_ONLY=1 and blank GEMINI_API_KEY, GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY, and OPERNROUTER_API_KEY. The server log shows 2 POST requests, both to /api/render (local template render), and no AI call.

Pages: on the desktop viewport 1280x800, 10 routes return HTTP 200. They are /, /projects, /projects/origins-3.1-a1, the lesson editor, the lesson preview, /compile, /teacher-manual/preview, /review, /review/quest-5/l01, and /projects/quest-4-a1. /settings returns 404. The 390x844 viewport covers /, /projects, and the project page. The 768x1024 viewport covers the project page.
Console and page errors: none on any page. The console holds only the React DevTools info line, HMR connected, and Fast Refresh lines. The page-error capture is empty after every navigation.

Icon render and alignment: 22 distinct icons render live. Each svg measures 16 x 16 px in buttons (h-4 w-4). It measures 20 x 20 px in card titles (h-5 w-5) and 12 x 12 px in the Secondary badge (h-3 w-3). The BookOpen and BookOpenCheck glyph box is 20 x 18 px in the new drawing, equal to the old drawing. Each icon sits left of its label with the mr-2 gap. I saw no clipped, doubled, or missing icon.

Vertical offset (dy) of each icon in its row is 0 px. The exceptions are -0.5 px for the logo and -1 px for the tab icons. GraduationCap (unchanged) and BookOpen (redrawn) both show -1 px in the same tab row. The tab style causes the offset, not the redraw.

Pixel measure: I rendered both drawings on a canvas and counted the changed pixels. The share is the changed pixels divided by the pixels with ink in either version. BookOpen shows 18.5 percent at 16 px, 20.7 percent at 24 px, and 21.4 percent at 96 px. BookOpenCheck 17.5, 20.1, and 21.1 percent. The unchanged Plus control shows 0 percent at all three sizes.

The violations are button-name (critical) and link-name (serious), both on the icon-only back control. The incomplete item is color-contrast on 2 lesson-title nodes. Snapshots show the same unnamed back control on 5 pages and 3 more unnamed icon-only buttons on the lesson editor.

Keyboard probe on /projects: 8 Tab presses reach 8 stops. The stops are the link and the button of Dashboard, Projects, Review, and Settings, in that order. The link shows the browser focus outline (outline auto 1px). The button uses the ring style (outline none, box-shadow ring). Screenshot 39 caught the ring in its 150 ms transition, so I did not measure the ring contrast.

Responsive: no horizontal page overflow at 1280, 768, or 390 px (scrollWidth equals the viewport width). The main column measures 1024, 512, and 134 px. At 390 px the content is cut off inside main (screenshot 22).

Loading states: /review/quest-5/l01 (screenshot 09) and /projects/quest-4-a1 (screenshot 10) show 'Loading...' and 'Loading lessons...' at capture time. The first dev compile of /api/packages took about 31 s under machine load, and agent-browser reported page_wedged twice. The icons that these two pages show after loading (Star and the page icons) were not seen.

No dialog, Select list, fullscreen preview, or loaded review page was captured, because the text find command did not match the buttons.
